_doc: EA -> MOHAA model swaps (same rules as fl_modelmap.json: only art from the player's own install or the mod's paks; nothing from the disc is shipped). 'trees': a tree-card texture whose card geometry is dropped and a stock 3D tree (BSP static model) is placed at each card cluster: origin at the cluster's trunk foot, scaled so model_height (units above the origin, tiki scale included) matches the card tree, lit with the cards' own mean vertex colour (verts = the model's vertex count), yaw from the spot. trunk_half / trunk_top (model units, scaled with the tree) give a solid trunk box inside the bark up to below the first branch, skipped where a wall stands within 40u. light_gain / light_desat dim and grey the light. 'trial': applied only when EA_TREE_TRIAL is set.

huO~.reason: [user-approved 2026-11-13: 'Yeah make them dim, trunks can stay solid'] the lone bare trees (193 card clusters, 214-403u tall, median 337u) -> the mod's winter common tree (MOHAA commontree mesh, 160 tris, its own distance sprite), dimmed (x0.48, half-way to grey: no blue glow) to sit with the disc's bare cards. Trunk box fitted inside the bark: half-width 6 model units (mesh trunk ~6.4-7u radius), up to 95 model units (first branch at ~100), scaled per tree.
